frontmatter.name: generate-hex-code
frontmatter.description: Generate cryptographically random, collision-checked 8-hex-char codes for this codebase's short-code conventions - log/diagnostic message codes (App.create_log_message, create_static_log_message, exception codes like exc.NoResultsError), and gen_epix.etl.model.Result subclass discriminators (ID, COMPLETED_CODE). Use whenever a new one of these codes is needed - never hand-type or pattern-invent one (e.g. sequential nibbles like "d4e5f6a7") since low-entropy hand-made codes are easy to collide

nodes.label: Layer Boundaries principle
nodes.rationale: Separates HTTP transport (API/setup files) from execution/data logic (service/repository layers): endpoints translate HTTP to commands and call app.handle(cmd); services execute behavior via unit-of-work through repositories.

nodes.label: Container Model (Dockerfile, gunicorn --preload)
nodes.rationale: --preload runs the app module once in the master process before forking workers, so AppCfg + AppComposer execute only once and the resulting FAST_API object is shared across all workers via copy-on-write.

nodes.label: Architectural Constraints table
nodes.rationale: Repository types bounded to DICT/SA_SQLITE/SA_SQL; policy enforcement must be centralized through App.handle() and never in routes; repository implementations must exist for both Dict and SQL backends with identical domain behavior.

nodes.label: Load and Overwrite Precedence (env var > Dynaconf > YAML pinned)
nodes.norm_label: load and overwrite precedence (env var > dynaconf > yaml pinned)
nodes.rationale: Even if the global effective level is raised (e.g. to DEBUG), pinned logger groups (sqlalchemy.engine, sqlalchemy.pool, httpx, asyncio, and local app namespace suffixes) keep their YAML level to avoid noisy third-party chatter.

nodes.label: casedb service (SA_SQL mode, embedded LOCAL seqdb)
nodes.norm_label: casedb service (sa_sql mode, embedded local seqdb)
nodes.rationale: seqdb must be healthy before casedb starts: both the standalone seqdb service and casedb's embedded LOCAL seqdb share the same seqdb database. Ordering ensures seqdb creates the root user first so casedb's embedded seqdb finds it already present; user_manager handles this idempotently but ordering eliminates any residual race condition.

nodes.label: Authentication vs Authorization Separation
nodes.rationale: Passing dependency-based authentication does not by itself grant command authorization; authentication (AuthService) and authorization (command policies/PDP) are intentionally separate layers.

nodes.label: Root Fallback and No-IDP Implications
nodes.rationale: If no IDP clients are configured, auth dependencies switch to _create_no_auth_dependencies(); running with no configured IDP materially changes trust posture and should be treated as a constrained mode.

nodes.label: Fallback Behavior (No IDPs configured)
nodes.rationale: When no IDP clients are configured, existing-user dependency can return the root user while new-user dependency still requires claims and fails on missing claims.

nodes.label: Security Risk Modes (no-IDP fallback, public listing, root privilege, IDP cap)
nodes.norm_label: security risk modes (no-idp fallback, public listing, root privilege, idp cap)
nodes.rationale: These runtime modes are implemented intentionally but change operational risk; supported for flexibility, not because they are equivalent in security posture.

nodes.label: OIDC-Only Identity Provider Support constraint
nodes.rationale: AuthService._init_idp_client initializes OauthIdpClient only when protocol==OIDC; other protocols raise NotImplementedError, so non-OIDC provider onboarding requires code changes, not config-only changes.

nodes.label: Trust Boundaries and Authority Model
nodes.rationale: Two authorities by design: external OIDC provider ecosystem establishes token validity; internal repository-backed user model plus policy engine decides what that identity may do now, like a passport checkpoint handoff.

nodes.label: Design Notes (Fire class-as-CLI, lazy imports, APP_URI/ETL_ENV dicts)

nodes.rationale: Heavy modules are imported inside each method (not module scope) to keep CLI startup time negligible regardless of invoked command; class-level dicts (APP_URI, ETL_ENV) centralise per-app config for O(1) lookup instead of conditionals.
